performance_claim_scope: W7900/gfx1100 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Q4_K_M/BF16-KV current Generation-2 engine vs retained old design, same p512/d128 SSE 20ms-batch-window protocol; quantifies the cost of the current physical-c2 shared-slot cap. NOT a retained topline.
decision: diagnostic only: the c8 gap (0.298x) is attributable entirely to lowering logical c8 into physical c2 groups; c4/c8 shared-slot qualification is the follow-up that should close it
note_on_passed: passed=false reflects the c8 live-admission sub-gate failure (server-side request-cancellation), a new-protocol-specific check, not the c1/c8 burst comparison which is clean and exact

hardware.note: rocminfo also lists an RX 7900 XTX on the host; both runs were pinned to device 0 = W7900

protocol.timing_boundary: SSE client cycle wall, simultaneous release to last completed response, generated-token numerator

current_generation2.engine: hipengine (Generation-2 EngineService, token_budget, global KV pool, registered shared-slot physical widths (1,2))

live_admission.reason: server-side request-cancellation (HTTP 499) on all 8 join requests; each generated ~86-93 of 128 tokens then finish_reason=error
live_admission.note: new-harness join-after-N-decode live protocol; differs from the old protocol's live test, so this is a G2 open issue, not part of the old/new apples-to-apples scope

c1_current_vs_old_streaming.interpretation: Generation-2 c1 is ~5.8% faster on the identical protocol (graph/workspace improvements); c1 is the cleanest apples-to-apples point

c8_current_vs_old_streaming.interpretation: Generation-2 c8 is ~70% slower because logical c8 lowers to physical c2 groups; the old design ran one physical c8. This gap is the target of shared-slot c4/c8 qualification.

caveats: Different source commits (current ad030591 vs old 2a1fafb8); the c8 delta is a physical-width-composition effect, not a kernel regression.
The old c8 used a single physical c8; the current c8 is capped at physical c2 by GGUF_SHARED_SLOT_AR_PHYSICAL_WIDTHS=(1,2).
c1 is the protocol-clean comparison; c8 isolates the c2-cap cost.

limitations: Diagnostic only; not a retained topline and not a release claim.
c8 live-admission sub-gate failed (server-side cancellation); open issue, not the apples-to-apples scope.
No c9/c13 rows were re-run under the current engine; the retained old c9/c13 rows are carried for context only.
next: Qualify shared-slot physical c4/c8 (byte-exact packed AR state oracle at rows 4 and 8, then F1 c1..c32 sweep) so logical c8 lowers to one physical c8.
Investigate the c8 live-admission server-side request-cancellation separately.
